name: Weapon Shop
desc1: This small, somewhat poorly-kept shop is full of all sorts of
desc2: implements of destruction. Most of them are quite shabbily crafted,
desc3: but some are good, and a select few are even skillfully made. A long
desc4: wooden counter up against the wall displays some of the better wares
desc5: here. The only exit is onto Dagger street, to the south.
